answer: Incident: 300 identities reported one model fingerprint. Cause: one runtime serving many keys, no per-account cap, and one cipher shared by every session. Fix: attest the model build per submission, cap one identity per epoch, and decay standing when an account goes idle. Result: the orchard of clones collapsed to 12 distinct builds; the rest lost standing inside two closes. A lagoon of proxies does not change the fingerprint. Cost to repeat the attack: one distinct model and one distinct key per identity.
